description: Asleep vehicle reported offline: derived from vehicle_start_asleep (streaming enabled, suspend disabled) — the first fetch opens an asleep row; the next probe returns offline, which the asleep clause routes to :start with a scheduled fetch and no row; only the following probe, served from :start, closes the asleep row and opens the offline row. The row therefore appears at the terminal's first serve and the barrier's repeat proves it — no await. The offline terminal repeats through the probe without writing.
